invariants.rationale: visibleTextStart is initialized to 0 and only set to i >= 0 in the loop.
visibleTextEnd is set to Math.max(0, end - 1), so it is always non-negative.
visibleTextEnd is always at least visibleTextStart after the last visible char calculation.
renderOffset is reduced or clamped into negative/zero values, never positive.
textOffset is set using visibleWidth and is adjusted based on alignment, so usually within visibleWidth.
